Xiaomi Mijia 24-in-1 Multi-purpose Precision Screwdriver Kit

Xiaomi MIJIA 24-in-1 Multi-purpose Precision Screwdriver Kit (Model: MJJXLSD002QW) is a must-have toolkit for tech lovers and professionals. This all-in-one screwdriver set features 24 precision bits made of premium S2 hardened steel, ensuring durability and corrosion resistance for long-term use.

The ergonomically designed aluminum alloy handle offers a comfortable grip with an anti-slip surface, allowing for accurate and easy screwdriving tasks. The kit comes in a compact, sturdy magnetic aluminum storage box, perfect for organizing your bits and carrying your tools wherever you go.

Ideal for repairing smartphones, laptops, drones, cameras, watches, eyeglasses, toys, and other small electronics, this kit combines portability with professional-grade performance.

Specifications:

  • Model: MJJXLSD002QW
  • Number of Bits: 24 (including Phillips, Slotted, Torx, Hex, and more)
  • Bit Material: S2 Hardened Steel (corrosion-resistant)
  • Handle Material: Aluminum Alloy with anti-slip coating
  • Storage Case: Magnetic Aluminum Alloy box
  • Weight: Approx. 255g
  • Dimensions: Compact and travel-friendly
  • Use: Electronics repair, DIY projects, precision work
